# sphinx-fuma

> Fumadocs theme for sphinx

## Pages

- [sphinx-fuma](index.html.md): A responsive Sphinx theme inspired by Fumadocs.
- [How to configure sphinx-fuma](docs/src/getting-started.html.md): This guide shows how to install sphinx-fuma, select it in Sphinx, and apply theme options.
- [Theme option reference](docs/src/theme-options.html.md): Theme options are entries in the Sphinx html_theme_options dictionary.
- [Content component showcase](docs/src/components.html.md): This page renders theme-native directives and commonly used Sphinx content with sphinx-fuma.
- [API Reference](autoapi/index.html.md): This page contains auto-generated API reference documentation 1.
- [sphinx_fuma](autoapi/sphinx_fuma/index.html.md): sphinx_fuma — a Sphinx theme with a fumadocs-style layout.
- [sphinx_fuma._files](autoapi/sphinx_fuma/_files/index.html.md): The files directive.
- [sphinx_fuma._nav](autoapi/sphinx_fuma/_nav/index.html.md): Structured navigation data for the templates.
- [sphinx_fuma._options](autoapi/sphinx_fuma/_options/index.html.md): Normalisation of html_theme_options into template-friendly context values.
- [sphinx_fuma._steps](autoapi/sphinx_fuma/_steps/index.html.md): The steps directive.
